officialBullets.receivingDoesNotRefresh: Receiving one does not refresh your usage; you choose when to use it before it expires.
officialBullets.where: Desktop: Settings > Usage & billing. Web: Usage settings. Not available in the mobile app. CLI: enter /usage and select Redeem reset.
officialBullets.eightyPercent: To use a banked reset from Usage settings, at least one allowance it covers must have less than 80% remaining. If all covered allowances have 80% or more remaining, you’ll see “Your usage does not need a reset right now,” and the reset stays available until you use it or it expires.
officialBullets.proFiveHour: 帮助中心对 Pro 100 / Pro 200 / Pro 500 只写 “The weekly allowance.”，没有把 5-hour allowance 列进这一条。Plus 与 Business Standard 写的是 “The 5-hour and weekly allowances.”。据此核对：Pro 只恢复周额度，不恢复 5 小时额度。
officialBullets.doesNotPermanentlyIncrease: These one-time resets are separate from your regular scheduled usage refresh. They do not permanently increase your plan’s limits or add usage credits.
officialBullets.refreshTime: Banked, global, and paid resets can change the next refresh time for the allowances they affect without changing your subscription billing date.

recheck.priorRepoCoverage: main 与本 PR 没有 2026-11-12 这条激活帖，也没有现行帮助中心这条 Plus vs Pro 恢复范围。较早研究文件（如 chatgpt-astra-quota-round8-2026-09-11.json）记过 2026-09 Astra 期间的 banked/global reset，以及「重置恢复额度、不永久提高套餐限额」，链接是旧文 how-banked-codex-resets-work。#234 已有 jeree-codex-5h100-weekly6-oral-x-2026-11-12.json（前帖口述 5h 100% / 周剩 6%），不是本轮激活。本轮新意是这一轮已激活，以及 Plus 恢复 5 小时 + 周额度、Pro 只恢复周额度。
recheck.userInventoryNotANewQuotaRow: kevinzhu 库存截图与 Jeree 兑换口述只作旁证，不写成新的实测额度行。
